title: fig-dataset-size-growth: training-data scales
caption: Two log-scale panels of landmark corpora — image counts for LeNet/AlexNet/ViT vs training tokens for GPT-3/Chinchilla/DeepSeek-V3/Qwen3 — with the ImageNet-1k reference line the chapter's ResNet-50 workload uses. Illustrates scale, not a fitted growth rate.

title: fig-cascades: the lifecycle failure arcs
caption: The book's cascade figure: early defects in framing and collection bypass intermediate validation and surface at evaluation and deployment. Our data-cascade.svg distils the same propagation plus the widening remediation-cost band.

title: fig-four-pillars: quality, reliability, scalability, governance
caption: Four pillars feeding the ML data system, with dashed trade-off edges — validation overhead vs throughput, consistency vs coordination, privacy vs performance, bias mitigation vs coverage.

title: margin: the false-wake multiplication
caption: Expected monthly false wakes on a log scale: ~2,592 at 99.9% per-window rejection, ~26 at 99.999% — both over the 1/month budget line. Same arithmetic as our false-wake-curve chart.

title: fig-pipeline-flow: end-to-end data pipeline
caption: Heterogeneous sources normalizing into unified storage, with labeling looping back and a governance boundary around everything — the map for the chapter's middle sections.

title: fig-mswc: forced-alignment labeling at scale
caption: How MSWC was built: forced alignment over continuous speech corpora + transcripts, sliced into >1M one-second keyword windows across 50 keywords and 5 languages — automated labeling as the throughput answer.

title: fig-spectrogram-example: waveform → spectrogram → MFCC
caption: Three aligned views of one audio sample — raw waveform, time-frequency spectrogram, 13-coefficient MFCC — the representation the KWS pipeline must compute identically on cluster and device.

title: physics: gravity vs task-relevant signal
caption: Data selection gain ∝ information entropy / data gravity — the book's lens for when moving/acquiring bytes is worth the signal they carry.

title: storage: the latency hierarchy
caption: Latency tiers across storage media — no medium is both cheap and fast, which is why training scans and serving lookups pull toward different tiers.

title: debt: compounding backlog
caption: The Debt_n ≈ Debt_0(1+r)^n heuristic drawn as a growth curve — the same shape as our illustrative debt-compound chart at three net rates.
